title: Power Redundancy and Reliability
summary: Identify single points of failure and redundant power paths in simplified models.
objectives: Connect redundancy to maintenance and monitoring.

vocab.def: Two modeled power paths intended to reduce dependence on one feed.
A component or area whose failure affects a defined portion of a system.
A change to an alternate available path or system.

sections.heading: Redundancy has dependencies
sections.body: Two feeds are not independent if they share the same upstream failure domain. Trace the whole model before calling it redundant.

practice.prompt: Two rack PDUs use separate cables but one upstream distribution point. What remains?
practice.answer: The shared distribution point remains a potential single point of failure.

quiz.question: What should you inspect before trusting an A/B path?

reflectionPrompt: What evidence would you request before approving maintenance on one path?
